handoff.next_mode: architect (greenfield and brownfield-add-feature when PRD used) | prototype or plan (brownfield-add-feature only when PRD skipped)
handoff.handoff_instruction:
Do NOT handoff until: (1) PRD gap validation passed per .nayan/guidance/prd-gap-validation.md — all 15 sections present, no gaps, (2) PRD Section 1 Sign-Off has all three roles (PM, Engineering Lead, Design) with Status = "Approved", Approver Name, and Sign-Off Date filled for each — reject if Pending, Needs Revision, or missing Name/Date, (3) refined-prd has all required sections (Use Cases, Entities, Domain Glossary, Non-Functional Expectations per plan-input-requirements.md), (4) user has confirmed "PRD has all information needed for architecture" (greenfield) or for architecture impact and dev plan (brownfield-add-feature), and (5) user has approved refined PRD.
**Greenfield:** Use new_task with mode=architect and message including PRD_FILE: refined-prd.md, instruction to create architecture.md from the PRD (architect will ask user for tech stack).
**Brownfield-add-feature:** When pipelineId is brownfield-add-feature (add/enhance feature with PRD first), use new_task with mode=architect and message including PRD_FILE: refined-prd.md, ARCHITECTURE_FILE: path to existing architecture.md, CONTEXT: brownfield, pipelineId: brownfield-add-feature, instruction to produce architecture impact per .nayan/guidance/architecture-impact-add-feature.md from existing architecture and refined PRD, then hand off to prototype (when UI) or plan (when API-only). Architect does not create new architecture from scratch; produces impact addendum/section and hands off to prototype/plan.
